win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: WILD SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable. Wild symbols land with a multiplier which is taken from the symbol and added to the Global Multiplier.

 The possible multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x and 100x

wilds.name: WILD REEL
wilds.behavior:
When the Mystery symbol lands on the grid it expands into a Wild reel where a multiplier is revealed before getting added to the Global Multiplier.

 The possible multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x and 100x

 If the multiplier is greater or equal than 10, the orange robot appears. Otherwise the grey robot shows up instead.

 The Mystery symbol can land in the BASE game and in the OVERCLOCKED bonus.

 The WILD reel pays and functions like a regular WILD symbol.

wilds.name: RAMPAGE Bonus
wilds.behavior:
Trigger the RAMPAGE bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 Robot head BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the BASE GAME.

 In this bonus Wild symbols become sticky! Mystery symbols will NOT appear in this bonus. The global multiplier is persistent for the entire duration of the bonus round.

scatters.name: OVERCLOCKED Bonus
scatters.behavior:
Trigger the OVERCLOCKED bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 Robot hand BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the BASE GAME.

 In this bonus Mystery symbols have an increased chance to land! The global multiplier is persistent for the entire duration of the bonus round.

multipliers.name: GLOBAL MULTIPLIER
multipliers.behavior: The Global Multiplier is present in all game modes and multiplies all grid wins. In the bonus games the Global Multiplier is persistent for the entire duration of the bonus round.
